title: BulkPriorCompletionService.execute()'s profileId branch bypasses DI and its bookmark write is never asserted
why: When execute() runs with a non-null profileId — the live path add_track_flow_screen.dart uses when a parent adds a track for a specific child — the service `new`s up a BookmarkRepositoryImpl directly instead of using the injected _bookmarkRepository, so no test double can intercept it (no seam). bulk_prior_completion_service_test.dart's execute() tests never pass profileId, so that branch never runs there at all. bulk_prior_completion_siyum_detection_test.dart does pass profileId (lines 333, 372) so the branch does run against a real in-memory DB, but neither test reads back the bookmarks table afterward — the branch's correctness (right profileId, right track resolved) is completely unverified. A bug here would silently point a child's bookmark at the wrong profile/track with no test failure.
recommendation: Parameterize bookmarkRepositoryProvider as a .family(profileId) (or inject a BookmarkRepository factory into BulkPriorCompletionService) so the profileId path goes through the same injectable seam as the rest of the class; add an assertion in bulk_prior_completion_siyum_detection_test.dart that reads back the bookmark row for the target profile and checks it points at the expected sefariaRef.
acceptance_criteria: A test calls execute(profileId: X) and then asserts (via a real or fake repository read) that the bookmark was written under profile X
bulk_prior_completion_service.dart contains no direct `BookmarkRepositoryImpl(` construction outside a provider
mergedFrom: Replace inline BookmarkRepositoryImpl construction in BulkPriorCompletionService with a DI seam
